comment: No manual for this version of tagh is published any more; the lines come from the panel, the maker's own control names and the product page. The product page puts the attenuator and the rectifier on the input and the slew on the output, while the maker's tooltip calls the attenuator 'Output Level'. The plugin also carries a second, unregistered tágh class with a Random Algorithm menu of stepped random, chaos and LFO modes; it is not the model the plugin installs, and the tágh that ships has no menu of its own.
